skill_addendum.note: Secrets Manager evidence may include additional supporting files beyond secrets.json. Use them when evaluating alerting/monitoring controls.

item.name: cloudwatch_alarms.json
item.use_for: SM-012 (rotation failure alerting) via CloudWatch metric alarms
item.rule: Do NOT claim alarms exist (or don't exist) unless this file contains relevant data for the audited region(s).

item.name: eventbridge_rules.json
item.use_for: SM-012 (rotation failure alerting) via EventBridge rules + targets
item.rule: Only assert alerting gaps if relevant rules/targets are missing in this evidence.

anti_hallucination.rule: Evidence references MUST be resolvable. Use JSON Pointer fragments (RFC 6901) where possible. Examples: secrets.json#/secrets/0, cloudwatch_alarms.json#/regions/us-east-1. Avoid shorthand anchors like secrets.json#db_user.
If alerting evidence is missing or contains access errors, either: (a) omit SM-012, or (b) include SM-012 with severity reduced and explicitly state "insufficient evidence".
